name: How long does a typical surface restoration project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical surface restoration project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a surface restoration project varies significantly based on the size of the area, the type of surface material, and the extent of the damage. A small concrete patio restoration might take a few days, while a large commercial facade could take several weeks. Weather conditions can also impact exterior projects, especially regarding curing times for sealants and coatings. We provide an estimated timeline after our initial assessment, which includes considering all these factors and discussing any potential delays.
